title: Firearm Volume 1 #15 December 1994 Malibu Comics ULTRAVERSE - James Robinson
descriptionText: The product is a comic book titled "Firearm Volume 1 #15 December 1994" published by Malibu Comics in the Ultraverse series. It is written by James Robinson, a prominent artist and writer in the US Comics tradition. This particular issue is part of a larger series of comics that focus on the character Firearm in the Ultraverse universe, offering readers a captivating and action-packed story arc created by Robinson.
